# Game Idea: Meteor Escape

Control a small ship with arrow keys on an HTML canvas. Meteors spawn from the top and fall faster over time. Survive as long as possible. **Lose condition:** the ship collides with a meteor or the timer reaches zero. Score equals survival time.

1: // Simple Meteor Escape game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (function(){
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   // Set canvas size to fill its container
7:   function resize(){
8:     canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
9:     canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
10:     // generate star field
11:     stars = [];
12:     for(let i=0;i<100;i++){
13:       stars.push({
14:         x: Math.random()*canvas.width,
15:         y: Math.random()*canvas.height,
16:         r: 0.5 + Math.random()*1.5
17:       });
18:     }
19:   }
20: 
21:   // Audio assets
22:   const backgroundMusic = new Audio('background.mp3');
23:   backgroundMusic.loop = true;
24:   const crashSound = new Audio('crash.wav');
25:   const thrustSound = new Audio('thrust.wav');
26:   let audioStarted = false;
27:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
28:   resize();
29: 
30:   // Ship definition
31:   const ship = {x:0, y:0, w:30, h:30, speed:200};
32:   function resetShip(){
33:     ship.x = canvas.width/2 - ship.w/2;
34:     ship.y = canvas.height - ship.h - 10;
35:   }
36:   resetShip();
37: 
38:   // Input handling
39:   const keys = {};
40:   window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{keys[e.key]=true; if(!audioStarted && (e.key==='ArrowLeft' || e.key==='ArrowRight' || e.key==='ArrowUp' || e.key==='ArrowDown')){ backgroundMusic.play(); audioStarted=true; } if(e.key==='ArrowLeft' || e.key==='ArrowRight' || e.key==='ArrowUp' || e.key==='ArrowDown'){ thrustSound.currentTime=0; thrustSound.play(); } });
41:   window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.key]=false});
42: 
43:   // Meteor definition
44:   const meteors = [];
45:   let stars = [];
46:   let spawnInterval = 1500; // ms
47:   let lastSpawn = 0;
48:   let meteorSpeed = 100; // px/s, will increase over time
49: 
50:   // Game state
51:   let startTime = null;
52:   let elapsed = 0;
53:   let gameOver = false;
54:   const gameDuration = 60; // seconds
55: 
56:   function spawnMeteor(){
57:     const size = 20 + Math.random()*30;
58:     meteors.push({x:Math.random()*(canvas.width-size), y:-size, w:size, h:size});
59:   }
60: 
61:   function update(dt){
62:     if(gameOver) return;
63:     // Move ship
64:     if(keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed*dt;
65:     if(keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed*dt;
66:     if(keys.ArrowUp) ship.y -= ship.speed*dt;
67:     if(keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += ship.speed*dt;
68:     // Clamp ship inside canvas
69:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width-ship.w, ship.x));
70:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height-ship.h, ship.y));
71:     // Spawn meteors
72:     if(performance.now() - lastSpawn > spawnInterval){
73:       spawnMeteor();
74:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
75:     }
76:     // Increase difficulty over time
77:     meteorSpeed = 100 + elapsed*10; // 10px/s per second
78:     // Update meteors
79:     for(let i=meteors.length-1;i>=0;i--){
80:       const m = meteors[i];
81:       m.y += meteorSpeed*dt;
82:       // Remove off‑screen meteors
83:       if(m.y > canvas.height) meteors.splice(i,1);
84:     }
85:     // Collision detection
86:     for(const m of meteors){
87:       if(!(ship.x+ship.w < m.x || ship.x > m.x+m.w || ship.y+ship.h < m.y || ship.y > m.y+m.h)){
88:         crashSound.currentTime=0;
89:         crashSound.play();
90:         gameOver = true;
91:         backgroundMusic.pause();
92:         break;
93:       }
94:     }
95:     // Timer check
96:     elapsed = (performance.now()-startTime)/1000;
97:     if(elapsed >= gameDuration) gameOver = true;
98:   }
99: 
100:   function draw(){
101:     // Background gradient
102:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,canvas.height);
103:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001d3d');
104:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000814');
105:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
106:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
107:     // Stars
108:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
109:     for(const s of stars){
110:       ctx.beginPath();
111:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
112:       ctx.fill();
113:     }
114:     // Draw ship as triangle
115:     ctx.fillStyle = '#00f';
116:     ctx.beginPath();
117:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x + ship.w/2, ship.y);
118:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
119:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
120:     ctx.closePath();
121:     ctx.fill();
122:     // Draw meteors with radial gradient
123:     for(const m of meteors){
124:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(m.x+m.w/2, m.y+m.h/2, m.w*0.1, m.x+m.w/2, m.y+m.h/2, m.w/2);
125:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff4e50');
126:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#c04848');
127:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
128:       ctx.beginPath();
129:       ctx.arc(m.x+m.w/2, m.y+m.h/2, m.w/2,0,Math.PI*2);
130:       ctx.fill();
131:     }
132:     // UI
133:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
134:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
135:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
136:     ctx.fillText('Time: '+(gameDuration-Math.max(0,Math.floor(elapsed))),10,20);
137:     if(gameOver){
138:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
139:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
140:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
141:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
142:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
143:       const score = Math.floor(elapsed);
144:       ctx.fillText('Game Over – Score: '+score, canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2);
145:     }
146:   }
147: 
148:   function loop(timestamp){
149:     if(!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
150:     const dt = (timestamp - (lastTime||timestamp))/1000;
151:     lastTime = timestamp;
152:     update(dt);
153:     draw();
154:     if(!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
155:   }
156:   let lastTime = 0;
157:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
158: })();

(End of file - total 158 lines)
</content>
